summary: Luda Technology Group Limited filed a Form 6-K on September 2, 2026, reporting a press release announcing that its subsidiary, Shenzhen Mayi Supply Chain Limited, entered into a one-year sales contract with Beijing Dasan Supply Chain Management Company for supplying rebar, wire rod, and steel pipe fittings. The contract ceiling value is approximately USD17.8 million (RMB120 million). No special-situation event is involved; it is a routine commercial contract disclosure. The filing provides no deal terms beyond the contract value. What to watch: execution risk and order flow under the framework.
